scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: A new category changes the contract
scenes.caption: Asha adds capacity alerts to the synthetic pipeline. Old latency and outage cases must still behave as specified. The revised draft accidentally changes the at-least-seventy comparison to greater than seventy.
scenes.dialogue: A new feature can break an old boundary.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: Write expected outcomes first
scenes.caption: The minimum pack covers a routine alert, exact threshold, malformed input, empty input, an identical repeat, partial output failure, the new category and a conflicting duplicate. Expected results come from the requirement, not from whatever the program happens to return.
scenes.dialogue: Retain both old and new cases.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Run and inspect the regression
scenes.caption: The exact-seventy case should request review. With a greater-than comparison it is recorded only, revealing the regression. Repair the comparison and rerun all eight cases, including capacity and failure handling.
scenes.dialogue: A repair needs a rerun, not only an edit.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose the response to a failing test
scenes.caption: Should Asha change the expected answer to match the bug, remove the boundary case, or repair the inclusive comparison and keep all eight tests?

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: A limited test record
scenes.caption: All eight specified cases pass after the repair while the new category stays enabled. The record supports those behaviours under the exercise contract. It does not prove every possible input or replace human review of policy changes.
scenes.dialogue: Passing tests are evidence with a scope.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Enter the regression lab
scenes.caption: Build the expected matrix, catch and repair the deliberate boundary regression and handle a fresh capacity case. Keep original results and tests when a requirement changes.
scenes.dialogue: Retest what changed and what should not change.
